#+TITLE: pullorg
#+AUTHOR: Jane Doe
#+OPTIONS: toc:2

* Introduction
=pullorg= is a /pull parser/ for [[https://orgmode.org][Org-mode]],
modelled on [[https://docs.rs/pulldown-cmark][pulldown-cmark]].

** Features
- Fast :: no allocations for most events
- Faithful :: follows =org-element.el=
- Small :: one dependency[fn:1]

** Installation
Add this to your =Cargo.toml=:

#+begin_src toml
[dependencies]
pullorg = "0.1"
#+end_src

* Usage
#+NAME: example-usage
#+begin_src rust
use pullorg::{html, Parser};

let parser = Parser::new("* Hello\n*world*");
let mut out = String::new();
html::push_html(&mut out, parser);
#+end_src

The output is:

#+begin_example
<h1>Hello</h1>
<p><b>world</b></p>
#+end_example
